name: WPRTS
recent: Westports 近期公布季度业绩，营收与净利同比大幅增长，但净利环比小幅下滑。同期，KWAP 在 9 月底至 11 月中期间多次申报股权变动。新闻方面，公司提到港口拥堵使运费维持高位，且最新业绩超出市场预期。
notable: KWAP 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利同比增长 26%。
媒体报道最新季度业绩超出市场预期。
risks: KWAP 在约两个月内多次申报股权变动，需留意大股东持股变化。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度营收为 MYR 1,068.39 million，同比增长 54.6%，环比增长 23.2%；净利为 MYR 342.56 million，同比增长 47.9%，环比下降 5.1%；净利率为 32.1%，低于上一季度的 41.6%。

recent_en: Westports recently reported quarterly results with strong year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit, though net profit declined slightly quarter-on-quarter. Meanwhile, KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest between late September and mid-November. In the news, the company noted port congestion keeping freight rates high, and its latest results beat estimates.
notable_en: KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest between September and November 2026.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit up 26% year-on-year.
Media reported that the latest quarterly results beat market estimates.
risks_en: KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholder interest over about two months; changes in major shareholder holdings warrant attention.
earnings_en: For 3Q 2026, revenue was MYR 1,068.39 million, up 54.6% year-on-year and 23.2% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 342.56 million, up 47.9% year-on-year but down 5.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 32.1%, lower than 41.6% in the previous quarter.
